text.en: Several clients highlight positive experiences with attending veterinarians, particularly commending Dr Q for attentive care and reassuring bedside manner. Reviewers also mention gentle interactions from technicians during routine pet examinations. While some pet owners report administrative disorganisation, individual clinical staff receive frequent praise.

Multiple reviewers express intense frustration over last-minute appointment cancellations, booking portal glitches, and prolonged waiting times. Clients report arriving for scheduled slots only to be informed of double-booking or lack of morning availability. Several pet owners note that scheduling instability caused unnecessary delays for sick animals.

title.en: Criticism of follow-up and test reporting

text.en: Pet owners report significant communication lapses, including lost laboratory samples, unreturned phone calls, and confusion regarding vaccination records. Reviewers note having to follow up repeatedly over several weeks to obtain basic diagnostic results. Several clients feel that front-desk personnel and managers failed to provide timely updates.

q.en: Are online appointment slots reliable at Banfield Hillcrest?

a.en: Reviewers report frequent discrepancies between online booking portals and actual clinic schedules, leading to cancellations.

q.en: How do clients rate communication regarding diagnostic test results?

a.en: Multiple clients report delays and lost samples, advising pet owners to follow up proactively for lab results.

q.en: Can pets receive preventive wellness care under subscription plans?

a.en: Yes, clients utilise Banfield wellness plans for routine vaccinations, though some report administrative billing issues.

q.en: Which veterinarians do clients recommend at this branch?

a.en: Reviewers specifically praise Dr Q for thorough, gentle veterinary care during consultations.
